commit.message: fix(ci): measure Magi production coverage separately

specification.objective: MAGI-013: ensure line/branch coverage reports and enforcement measure only the four Magi production Python files, excluding tests from denominator; start with evidence-based >90% line gate.

requirements.statement: Exclude tests from instrumentation and reports, and report exactly __init__.py, core.py, runtime_bridge.py and dashboard/plugin_api.py, preserving branch measurements.
Explicit >90% production line gate in both POLIS coverage adapter and verify.sh, with per-file missing line/branch output.
Document measured baseline production and global difference plus reproduction command; preserve Magi 1.7.8.

acceptance_criteria.statement: Script regression proves coverage run excludes tests/ and XML/report include the four production modules with branch measurement.
Production line threshold is >90% and a test proves the production denominator is not contaminated by tests; green POLIS coverage adapter passes with live measured lines and failures remain nonzero.
Documentation includes production and global baseline metrics, reproduction and limitations, with no version bump.

invariants.statement: Existing plugin, memory and Hermes APIs are untouched; only CI/quality scripts, test, docs and tracked POLIS artifacts may change.

forbidden_states.statement: A coverage report includes tests/ in its production denominator or claims >95% production coverage from the global report.

inputs.statement: Baseline d9c72a8, coverage global line-rate 96.45%, production subset 846 statements with 72 missed, ~91.49% line coverage.

outputs.statement: Production-specific coverage script, matching POLIS/verify threshold, script regression and README/CHANGELOG documentation.

failure_semantics.statement: Coverage below threshold, missing report or tests failure yields nonzero exit.
